name: Yoo Ha
source:
Kaira is a potential love interest. When the three roommates accidentally soak her during their car wash, she is the one to carry her luggage, give her a towel, and cut apples in the shape of bunnies for her as an apology.

From [url=https://maybeinteractive.fandom.com/wiki/Flower_Lane:_A_Record_of_Romance#Main] Maybe: Interactive Fandom Wiki
